events.quote: The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the respondent has issued a show cause notice dated 27.12.2023 to the petitioner by uploading the same in the GST portal, without serving physical copy of the same to the petitioner.
Since the petitioner failed to file reply to the said show cause notice, the respondent has confirmed the proposals contained in the show cause notice and passed the present impugned order.
The challenge in this Writ Petition is to the order dated 28.04.2024 passed by the respondent for the AY 2018-19 and to quash the same.

defects_argued.quote: Therefore, this Court finds that there is a lack of opportunities being provided to serve the notices/orders etc., effectively to the petitioner.

In such circumstances, this Court is of the view that the impugned assessment order came to be passed without affording any opportunity of personal hearing to the petitioner, confirming the proposals contained in the show cause notice.

outcome.quote: i) The impugned order passed by the respondent dated 28.04.2024 is set aside.
